mic.disabledHint: Wait for the current reply to finish before starting voice.

view.title: Live voice
view.savedNote: Everything said here is saved in this chat as text.

hint.bargeIn: Just start talking to cut in at any time.

ended.max_length: Voice ended after reaching the 15-minute session limit.
ended.idle: Voice ended after two minutes of silence.
ended.error: Voice stopped because something went wrong.
ended.replaced: Voice ended here because it was opened somewhere else.

phone.backgrounded: Voice stopped when the screen locked or you left the app; tap to talk again.

error.micDenied: The microphone was blocked, so allow microphone access in your browser's site settings and try again.
error.micMissing: No microphone was found, so plug one in and try again.
error.micBusy: Another app is using the microphone, so close it and try again.
error.unsupported: This browser cannot run live voice, so open this desk in a current version of Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
error.insecure: Voice needs a secure HTTPS page, so open this desk over https and try again.
error.voice_disabled: Voice is not turned on for this desk, so enable it in Settings first.
error.gateway_blocked: This desk has no working {gatewayName} key yet, so connect one in Settings and try again.
error.voice_session_limit: Too many voice sessions are open right now, so try again in a moment.
error.voice_model_unavailable: The voice model is not answering right now, so try again shortly.
error.connect: Could not connect to voice, so check your connection and try again.
error.thread: Could not open the conversation to save these turns, so reload the chat and try again.
